lessons.rule: A successful API response is not proof of a useful improvement. Require actual target evidence; do not auto-promote.
Keep the same explicit target across artist, programmer and auditor. Do not paste a generated terrain reference over a continuous shader-driven ground.
Inspect real PNG alpha and shape; near-opaque alpha can be 254. Reject visual drift independently of technical pass.
The previous local mill shader candidate produced negligible visible impact in matched Unity captures. Preserve original; do not repeat micro-adjustments without a materially new hypothesis.
Compare same camera, source SHA and fixture; distinguish technical verification, subjective quality and gameplay evidence. Prefer cheap source tests before native Windows.
Keep timeout reservations and stop downstream calls when usage is missing. Never treat uncertain cost as zero.
